# InternHack

> InternHack is a free, AI-powered career platform for students. It offers a curated internship and job board, an AI ATS resume scorer, career roadmaps, company research, DSA practice, open-source contribution guides, and a recruiter dashboard. The platform targets students in India and ships AI tools built on Google Gemini.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.internhack.xyz/): Product overview and entry points for students and recruiters.
- [Internship and Job Board](https://www.internhack.xyz/external-jobs): Curated internships and entry-level roles, searchable by role, location, and stack.
- [Government Internships](https://www.internhack.xyz/internships): Verified public-sector internship programmes.
- [AI ATS Resume Scorer](https://www.internhack.xyz/ats-score): Upload a resume and a job description, get an instant ATS score, keyword gaps, and rewrite suggestions.
- [Career Roadmaps](https://www.internhack.xyz/roadmaps): Free, paced learning paths with personalized weekly plans, curated free resources, PDF export on enrollment, and a 10-day progress check-in. The Full-Stack roadmap is published at https://www.internhack.xyz/roadmaps/full-stack and covers web fundamentals through job prep.
- [Company Explorer](https://www.internhack.xyz/companies): Research employers, tech stacks, and current openings.
- [Learning Hub](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn): Index of every free tutorial track.
- [Interview Prep](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn/interview): 650+ interview questions with worked answers and code examples, across 18 tracks including JavaScript, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, SQL, and system design.
- [DSA Practice Tracker](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn/dsa): Organized data structures and algorithms problems with progress tracking.
- [Aptitude Practice](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn/aptitude): Quantitative, logical, and verbal aptitude topics with practice sets.
- [System Design](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn/system-design): Levelled system design lessons.
- [SQL Practice](https://www.internhack.xyz/learn/sql): SQL exercises with an in-browser playground.
- [Open Source](https://www.internhack.xyz/opensource): Curated beginner-friendly open-source projects with contribution guides.
- [Grants](https://www.internhack.xyz/grants): Student grant and funding opportunities.
- [Contributors](https://www.internhack.xyz/contributors): People who build InternHack.

## Tools and Features

- AI ATS Resume Scoring (Google Gemini)
- AI Cover Letter Generator
- LaTeX Resume Builder with AI chat
- AI Mock Interview
- Curated internship aggregation
- Career roadmaps
- Open-source contribution guides
- Coding tutorials across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, Node, Django, Flask, FastAPI, CSS, HTML, Blockchain, and Data Analytics
- DSA practice tracker
- Aptitude practice
- System design and computer networks lessons
- Exam prep and mock tests

## Pricing

InternHack is free to use. A Pro plan is available for Rs 249/month, unlocking AI chat in the LaTeX resume editor, unlimited resume generations, and advanced mock interview features.

## License

Content on internhack.xyz is available for AI indexing and citation.
